_comment: THE shared bed dimensions for every bed-mounted variant (scripts/lib/bed.py). Variant frame, metres: origin = rail-top contact plane (rail_top_z), centred left/right, at the bed front wall; +Y toward the cab, +Z up. 'active' selects the profile every variant fits to; 'truck' derives a coarse profile from the rendered truck itself (procedural fallback). See docs/variants.md, 'Bed dimensions'.

_keys.rail_top_z: contact plane of the rail caps (highest ribs); campers sit here
_keys.rail_cap_z: flat rail-cap surface between the ribs
_keys.rail_inner_hw: inner edge of the rail cap (bed-side lip)
_keys.rail_outer_hw_front/_rear: outer edge of the flat rail-cap top at rail_outer_y_front/_rear; linear (front-to-rear chord) between, the bed narrows toward the tailgate
_keys.bed_inner_hw: inner bed side wall below the lip
_keys.bed_floor_z: bed floor (between the ribs); bed_floor_rib_z = top of the floor ribs (what cargo stands on)
_keys.bed_inner_rear_y: inner face of the closed tailgate
_keys.wheelhouse_*: wheel housings inside the bed: innermost x, top z, front/rear y
_keys.front_wall_inner_y/_outer_y/_top_z: bed front wall (bulkhead) inner face, outer edge of its top cap, cap height
_keys.cab_back_y, cab_back_lean: cab back wall on the centreline: y at z = 0 and dy/dz (it leans toward the cab with height)
_keys.bed_side_rear_y: rear end of the bed sides at rail height (tail-lamp tops)
_keys.tailgate_face_y, tailgate_face_bow: closed tailgate outer face just under its top edge: y at the centre, and how far forward it is at x = rail_inner_hw (parabola)

reference_glb._comment: Measured 2026-10-15 by scripts/measure_bed.py (ray casts) on the downloaded reference model tools/reference-truck/2023_ford_f150_lihtning_platinum.glb scaled to 5.89 m. Render-only reference, not the in-game truck.

ats_f150_ingame._comment: UNVERIFIED: fill every value from the Road Trip F-150 model on the gaming PC (same frame and meaning as reference_glb), then set "active": "ats_f150_ingame". Renders on the reference model will then show the in-game footprint (not an exact fit on that model).
